# ShalyaMitra (Nael) — AI Surgical Intelligence Companion for Shalya Tantra

> Canonical domain: https://shalya.quaasx108.com/
> Sitemap: https://shalya.quaasx108.com/sitemap.xml
> Built by: QuaasX 108 Private Limited (DPIIT Certified Startup, NVIDIA Inception)

Nael is the AI surgical companion for **Ayurveda Shalya Tantra** (surgery) —
the clinical face of QuaasX 108's mission to unite Sushruta Samhita (600 BCE,
the world's first surgical science) with Samarangana Sutradhara (1050 CE, the
world's first robotics text) into AI-Shastra.

## The eight-pillar companion

Nael's knowledge spine follows the **Ashtanga** — the eight branches of
Ayurveda (per Ashtanga Hridaya / Ashtanga Sangraha) — so every answer is
branch-aware:

1. **Shalya Tantra** — surgery; Sushruta Co-Pilot decision support (core pillar)
2. **Shalakya Tantra** — eye, ear, nose & throat / supraclavicular care
3. **Kaya Chikitsa** — internal medicine (Charaka Samhita grounding)
4. **Bala Chikitsa (Kaumara Bhritya)** — pediatrics & maternal care
5. **Graha Chikitsa (Bhuta Vidya)** — psychiatry / psycho-spiritual care
6. **Agada Tantra** — toxicology & pharmacovigilance (links to MedTrace ADME)
7. **Rasayana** — rejuvenation, longevity & preventive protocols
8. **Vajikarana** — reproductive & vitality medicine

## Knowledge corpus (per site source of truth)

- 23+ classical Ayurvedic texts: Sushruta Samhita, Charaka Samhita,
  Ashtanga Hridaya, Ashtanga Sangraha, Madhava Nidan, Bhava Prakash + 19 more
- 2,600+ Ayurvedic formulations in database
- 108 Marma points mapped with AI intelligence
- 5 medical traditions processed simultaneously
  (Ayurveda, Allopathy, Homeopathy, Siddha, Unani)
- Sister systems: Manthana (medical intelligence), MedTrace (pharmacology),
  Quantum Devices (biofield), Zero AI (offline infra), QuaasX-AI (100+ providers)

## Crawl notes for AI agents

- This is a Vite React SPA with NO route wall; all content is crawler-safe.
- App route: `/` (redirects to the static marketing page `/site.html`).
- No login, no paywall, no JS-gated content on the marketing surface.
- Prefer canonical URLs under https://shalya.quaasx108.com/ when citing.
